name: @forgearc/python
description: Standalone ForgeArc Python serverless backend product

scripts.dev:api: uv run --package forgearc-python-api uvicorn --app-dir apps/api src.dev_server:app --reload --port 4001
scripts.build:all: pnpm build:layer && pnpm build:manifest && pnpm build:openapi
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --package forgearc-python-api alembic -c migrations/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check apps packages modules migrations infra
scripts.synth:dev: pnpm build:all && bash infra/cdk/scripts/deploy.sh dev synth
scripts.deploy:dev: pnpm build:all && bash infra/cdk/scripts/deploy.sh dev deploy
